text: Funtankit!
Gattu, look! We have so many orders!
No problem! Burger is cake!
Gattu will cook without break!
Food Express!
Order right!
You will get coins day and night!
The link is given in the description!
Download quickly the Puntankit's game and the fun begins!
Teacher's Day Surprise
Today was Teacher's Day
and Gattu Chinky was very excited
while going to school in the morning!
Today the surprise we are going to give to the teachers?
Everyone will definitely be happy with it! Isn't it, Tinky?
Yes, Kato!
But you keep your happiness under control!
It is clearly visible from your face!
That we remember that today's Teacher's Day
and we are planning something!
Okay, okay!
Then I will make a complete normal face!
Like this?
This is very funny, Kato!
Okay, then let's go to school quickly!
A lot of preparations are still left!
Gattu Chinky reached the school quickly!
They had already made a plan with all the children of the class!
As soon as the class is start
and that sir comes to the class
all the children stand up and say
Good morning, sir!
And then everyone sits quietly!
Thank you, kids!
What?
That sir thinks in his mind!
What is this?
The children did not even wish me teacher's Day!
How can this happen?
Maybe they will do it after the class!
Thinking this, Matt sir starts teaching everyone!
Hurry and Bunty stand up and say to Sir!
Sir, Sir!
Sir thinks that Hurry and Bunty are going to wish him first!
But it does not happen like this!
Yes, yes, Hari, say!
Sir, can we go to the washroom?
What?
Oh, you want to go to the washroom?
Okay, okay!
Go!
Hurry and Bunty quickly leave the class!
And instead of going to the washroom
they quickly go down to the dance class!
Bunty, did you see how sad Sir was looking?
Because nobody wished him the teacher's Day!
It doesn't matter, Hari!
Just wait till the school ends
and then all the teachers will be double happy
instead of being sad!
You are right, Bunty!
Let's start the decoration!
Hari and Bunty quickly start blowing the balloons
that were already kept in the dance room!
Do it quickly, Hari!
We can't take a long bathroom break!
Yes, let's do this last thing!
Then someone else will come and do the rest of the work!
After inflating some balloons,
Hari and Bunty go back to the class!
After some time of their arrival
two more children get up
and ask the Sir to go to the washroom!
Sir, can we go to the washroom?
Okay, go!
Just like this, the children go one by one
and do a little bit of decoration every time!
The match period gets over
and now Sir was very sad!
He goes to the staff room!
Today something happened
which I had never thought of!
Not a single child wished me on teachers Day!
How can this happen, Sir?
Have all the children forgotten?
It can happen!
Next period is yours only, Ma'am!
You go and see!
Maybe the children will remember?
Yes, Sir! I'm going!
As soon as the bell rings,
English Ma'am comes to the class!
But no child wishes her either!
Ma'am even asks everyone once!
Kids, write this homework in the diary
and you'll are not forgetting anything, right?
What? What are we forgetting, Ma'am?
We even got yesterday's homework checked!
No, nothing got to come!
Let's start reading the lesson!
Ma'am starts teaching all the children!
Even in between English Ma'am's period,
some children get up and go to the washroom
and start decorating the dance room!
By the last period, a lot of decoration had been done!
But when Goodie and Monty go to the washroom in the last period,
now we just have to put this happy teacher's day up there
and we have to put these balloons on the wall
and this cake on the table!
I will put that happy teacher's day banner right now!
Give it to me, Goodie!
No, no, Monty! Not you!
I will do this work!
You will spoil everything!
Hey, no! I will do it!
Give it to me, Goodie!
Monty starts to grab the happy teacher's day banner from Goodie!
No, I won't give it to you!
The banner gets torn in all this!
And Monty gets one half and Goodie the other!
Not only this, Monty falls on some balloons!
Due to which the balloons also burst!
Oh no!
What have you done, Monty?
You messed up everything!
What did I do?
You were the one not letting it go!
Now what will we say to Gertoo Chinky?
Everything got messed up in the end moment!
And this is the last period!
Goodie and Hari come back to the class!
And Goodie slowly says to Gertoo and Chinky!
Gertoo Chinky, everything got messed up!
Monty tore the happy teacher's day banner in half!
And with it some balloons also burst!
What? Oh no! What should we do now?
There is only half an hour left for this period to end!
And even for the washroom break, we can go only for 10 minutes!
Let's do one thing Chinky!
Gertoo whispers something in Chinky's ear!
And then both of them go to the man in a sick condition!
What happened children?
Ma'am, I am having pain in my stomach!
Can we go to the restroom and take a little rest?
Yes ma'am, I am also having pain!
And what? How can both of you have pain together?
Actually ma'am, we must have eaten something wrong and lunch!
What? Okay, it's fine children!
Be careful!
Thank you ma'am!
Gertoo Chinky quickly go out!
And then come to the dance room!
Gertoo and Chinky get worried seeing all the mess over there!
Chinky, only few balloons are left!
And what will we do with the banner?
Gertoo, you take care of the balloons and put them on the wall!
I will fix the banner back with tape!
Okay Chinky!
Gertoo quickly inflates the balloons and puts them on the wall!
And Chinky fixes the banner again!
After this both of them put the cake on the table!
All the decoration was complete!
When the closing bell rang and Gertoo Chinky come back to their class!
What happened Gertoo Chinky?
Everything is done, isn't it?
Yes Gertoo, all done!
Now only thing left is to surprise the teachers!
After the school is over, all the teachers were in the staff room!
This is a really strange thing!
Today none of the children wish does not teach us day!
Right sir, none of the children remembered what it is today!
Right ma'am, what can be worse than this that our children don't even remember this!
No problem, now we have to go to home!
All the teachers were just arranging their things!
When Gertoo came running to the staff room!
Sir sir, ma'am, all of you please come with us quickly!
Chinky and Gudi had a fight!
Gudi, Gudi pushed Chinky and Chinky got hurt!
They are all in the dance room!
All of you please come with me quickly!
Hearing this, all the teachers get worried!
They go out and quickly follow Gertoo to the dance room!
When they arrive, the lights of the room were off!
Hey Gertoo, it is so dark here!
Where are Chinky and Gudi?
Then suddenly the lights turn on!
And all the children present there say together!
Have a happy day Gertoo!
Seeing all the children with such lovely decorations,
the teachers get surprised!
Mathsah is so happy that he gets emotional!
Hey, what's this, children?
You did all this for us?
I thought you all forgot!
Yes, children, I thought you all did not remember that today's teachers take!
Mom, how was it possible that we forgot that today's teachers take?
You always do so much for us!
So we can at least do this much for you!
Chinky is right!
There is only one day in the year!
When we can say thank you to you all!
How can we forget this day?
All the children are very happy to hear this!
And then all the teachers cut the cake together!
Happy teachers day!
